svg.title: FiberNet: fixed 3D geometry and saved material response
svg.desc: Left: camera orbit of the saved 64-node, 441-edge braced cubic graph. Right: saved kagome tensile recruitment frames; these are separate examples, not a coupled experiment. The poster shows the final saved loading frame.
svg.text: Graph geometry. Material response. One network language.
Depth shading only · no physical motion
Separate examples. Threshold: 5% of frame-max positive strain; contact off. Colors are not total force flow.
